summary: Jianzhi Education Technology Group filed a Form 6-K disclosing a registered direct offering of 12,000,000 American Depositary Shares (ADSs) at $0.45 per ADS, raising gross proceeds of approximately $5.4 million. The company entered into a securities purchase agreement with certain purchasers on August 13, 2026, and intends to use net proceeds for working capital and general corporate purposes. The offering is part of the company's shelf registration statement on Form F-3 (File No. 333-283260), with closing subject to standard conditions. Cayman counsel Conyers Dill & Pearman issued a legal opinion. What to watch: completion of offering and use of funds.
